imageVerbalizerSpec.description: Defines the the specs for image verbalization.

numThreadsForVerbalization.description:
The number of threads to use for parallel verbalization of images for API-based models.
If it is a local visual language model, this is ignored since the verbalization will be performed serially.

layoutModel.description: The name of the model used for layout detection.

captionModel.description: The name of the model used for caption generation.

detectionThreshold.description: The threshold value for object detection confidence. The range is [0, 1].

keywords.description:
The list of keywords used for identifying image-related blocks.
e.g. ["figure", "fig", "image", "diagram", "graph", "chart", "note", "plot"]

raiseOnError.description: If true, errors in image parsing will be raised instead of only logged.
